entry.title: MD Glitch 0.2.5
entry.summary: Gen1 CPU work: about half the CPU on the MPC Live II, at every setting. The codec's output is bit-identical to 0.2.4, so the sound is unchanged. The work: NEON for the transform, quantiser and band filters on armv7, no library call per rounded coefficient, and the band filters run a block at a time. Details and benches are in docs/DESIGN.md. Live II (one A17 core, % of a 128-frame block, p99): Gens 1 7.5% -> 4.1%, Gens 8 13.6% -> 7.6%. - `MD-Glitch-0.2.5-mpc-armv7.zip`: Gen1. Tested on an MPC Li

entry.title: MD Glitch 0.2.4 (beta)
entry.summary: First public release. A failing portable disc recorder for the MPC: a low-bitrate transform codec with up to eight re-encodes, an anti-skip buffer that stutters, drops out and jumps (Bump and Freeze keys), and a digital input with clock slips and bit errors. PANEL page with a live display, EDIT page with every control. - `MD-Glitch-0.2.4-mpc-aarch64.zip`: Gen2. Tested on an MPC Key 37 (MPC OS 3.10.1.12). - `MD-Glitch-0.2.4-mpc-armv7.zip`: Gen1. Tested on an MPC Live II. On Gen1, keep Gens at 1-2
